dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Haha, well, that might be a slight exaggeration... But no matter how you string it, we've certainly made a seventh at least!

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Though many workshops over in the Court of Fontaine have adopted mechanized production methods of late, I can guarantee you that every instrument from our workshops is 100% meticulously handcrafted. You could say this is how we uphold tradition.

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: In any case, should you wish to order any instruments, simply let me know.
